title: Concept: Dynamic code evaluation via eval (php) — review required
description: In php, eval turns a string into running code. Evaluation sinks collapse the data/code boundary, so any untrusted bytes in the string become an injection primitive. The php-specific remedy is data-only handling via a dispatch table or expression parser.
applicability: php codebases that build code or expressions from strings via eval; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Code execution in the application process when untrusted input reaches the sink; HIGH severity because evaluation sinks rarely constrain what the injected code can do.
